source.surface: generated conversation summary awaiting a decision to publish it as a thread
source.attribution: Screen curated by Mobbin (https://mobbin.com). Inspected remotely through the Mobbin MCP under accessMode 'remote-mcp'. No image was downloaded, cached, embedded, or stored anywhere in this repository; every value below is our own reading of the rendered screen.

evidenceTier.rationale: Mobbin is a curated gallery of captured screens. It is not a live observation we made of a running product, and no audience outcome is attached, so it cannot be silver/M2 or gold/M3. Treat these facts as evidence that a shipped product once looked this way, not as evidence that it worked.

decisionColour.acceptControlTreatment: solid violet fill with a white label and a white leading glyph
decisionColour.rejectControlTreatment: no reject control is offered; the two non-committing actions are Regenerate response and Copy text, both unfilled
decisionColour.undecidedContainerTreatment: plain white card with a hairline border on the page background; no tint of the commit hue
decisionColour.verdict: Exactly one of the three actions carries the fill, and it is the one that publishes. The undecided summary card itself is neutral.
